title: The Oak Father's Embrace

sources.title: Order of Nature
markers: | description = [[Undead]] creatures that hit the wearer receive {{DamageText|1d6|Radiant}} damage. [[Beasts]] that hit the wearer deal an additional {{DamageText|1d6|Radiant}} damage.

summary: Medium Armour harms Undead attackers but exposes the wearer to Beasts.

fields.Defence: Medium Armour proficiency. AC 13 plus Dexterity modifier, maximum +2 from Dexterity.
fields.Order of Nature: Undead hitting the wearer take 1d6 Radiant. Beasts hitting the wearer add 1d6 Radiant to their attack. Redirected damage does not trigger it.
fields.Acquisition: Headless skeleton near the owlbear nest and egg.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
